$comment: The sub packs of this language: one school day of REVIEW for one grade. Which blocks, how long, which teaching point and worksheet type. WRITTEN by scripts/sub-plans/lists/build-en-defs.js (edit the lists there). Everything else is filled by scripts/sub-plans/assemble.js. status 'pilot' = noindex, in no sitemap, linked from nowhere. Times are seat-work times a class of that grade can hold; the day's read-aloud, movement and quiet reading come from the class information sheets, not from worksheets.
